canned_responses.trigger: What to submit in viva portal, deliverables, report pdf

canned_responses.title: SQLite3 vs SQLAlchemy in Project Requirements
canned_responses.trigger: Can I use raw sqlite3? Is SQLAlchemy compulsory?
canned_responses.response: Using SQLite3 directly is acceptable as long as your application satisfies all database and CRUD requirements. However, SQLAlchemy ORM is strongly recommended because it simplifies object-relational mapping, manages sessions cleanly, and prevents raw SQL syntax/injection bugs. SQLite3 is the underlying storage database file, while SQLAlchemy is the Python ORM layer interacting with it.
tips: Both satisfy requirements.
Store the .sqlite3 or .db file in the project root.
Define clear foreign key relationships.

canned_responses.title: Role-Based Access Control (Admin vs User)
canned_responses.trigger: How to implement admin role, RBAC, user roles
canned_responses.response:
To implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):
1. In your User model, include a `role` field (e.g. `role = db.Column(db.String(20), default='user')`).
2. In MAD 1 (Flask): Write a custom decorator (e.g. `@admin_required`) that inspects `session['role'] == 'admin'` and aborts with HTTP 403 Forbidden if not authorized.
3. In MAD 2 (Vue + JWT): Ensure API endpoints verify user identity and claims from the JWT token, and the Vue router navigation guard (`router.beforeEach`) checks user role before allowing access to `/admin` views.
tips: Always check roles on the backend API, not just frontend router.
Never trust client-side role flags alone.
Always hash passwords using Werkzeug or bcrypt.

canned_responses.title: Celery Worker & Redis Setup for Daily Reminders
canned_responses.trigger: Celery beat not running, Redis connection refused, background tasks
canned_responses.response:
For background tasks and daily scheduled alerts in MAD 2:
1. Start your local Redis server: `redis-server` (ensure port 6379 is listening).
2. Launch your Celery worker: `celery -A main.celery worker --loglevel=info`.
3. Launch Celery Beat for scheduled daily reminders: `celery -A main.celery beat --loglevel=info`.
Ensure your Celery configuration points to `redis://localhost:6379/0` for both broker and result backend.
tips: Always start Redis before Celery.
Use MailHog or an SMTP test server for local email verification.
Ensure beat schedule timezone matches your local time.

canned_responses.title: CORS Error & Fetch API Integration in Vue
canned_responses.trigger: CORS blocked, Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Vue fetch error
canned_responses.response:
If you encounter CORS errors when calling your Flask API from Vue:
1. In your Flask backend: Install `flask-cors` and enable it: `from flask_cors import CORS; CORS(app, resources={r'/*': {'origins': '*'}})`. 
2. For authenticated requests: Ensure your Vue fetch/axios configuration includes `headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${{token}}` }`.
3. If handling cookies: Set `supports_credentials=True` in Flask CORS and `credentials: 'include'` in Vue fetch.
tips: CORS is a browser security mechanism, test APIs in Postman first.
Check preflight OPTIONS status code (should be 200).
Store JWT token in localStorage/sessionStorage.

canned_responses.title: Bonus Marks & Mock Test Criteria
canned_responses.trigger: How to get bonus marks? Mock test criteria
canned_responses.response: For MAD courses, bonus marks (typically 5 marks) are awarded if your average across course mock tests exceeds the benchmark (e.g. average > 40/100 across specified tests). There are no separate course-specific activities beyond the announced mock assessments. Bonus marks are added to your final consolidated course score before grade boundaries are determined.
tips: Attempt all scheduled mock tests.
Check syllabus PDF for exact term benchmark.
Added to final normalized score.

error_matrix.error: OperationalError: table has no column named ...
error_matrix.cause: Model was updated in SQLAlchemy, but SQLite schema was not migrated.
error_matrix.solution: Delete the local .sqlite3 file and re-run `db.create_all()`, or use Flask-Migrate to alter the table schema without data loss.

error_matrix.cause: User is authenticated but role check failed in decorator.
error_matrix.solution: Verify session role payload upon login. Ensure database user record has `role='admin'` and decorator checks `session.get('role') == 'admin'`.

error_matrix.error: CORS policy: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present
error_matrix.cause: Vue frontend on port 8080 calling Flask backend on port 5000 without CORS headers.
error_matrix.solution: Initialize `CORS(app)` in Flask application factory, or configure Vue devServer proxy in `vue.config.js`.

error_matrix.cause: Redis server is not running on the system.
error_matrix.solution: Run `redis-server` in a separate terminal or `sudo service redis-server start` before starting Celery workers.

error_matrix.cause: Access token lifetime elapsed without refresh token or re-login.
error_matrix.solution: Implement a router navigation guard in Vue (`router.beforeEach`) to intercept 401 responses and redirect the user to `/login`.

error_matrix.error: All Viva Slots Full on Portal
error_matrix.cause: Slot demand exceeded initial release capacity.
error_matrix.solution: Wait for instructor announcement; additional slots are released in subsequent windows (typically 10 PM or 10 AM).
